rows.label: tlk4440008902_msg0001
rows.name:
All right, everyone! Describe your
ideal lover in writing. I'll show you
an example first.

rows.label: tlk4440008902_msg0002
rows.name:
Standing tall, slender like a
Gypsum Tree...

rows.label: tlk4440008902_msg0003
rows.name:
Crimson lips parted, he
whispered, softly, words that
flowed like Melosian Honey...

rows.label: tlk4440008902_msg0004
rows.name:
Eyes like Pione Stones turn a burning
gaze toward me...

rows.label: tlk4440008902_msg0005
rows.name:
Ah... So beautiful... My heart is
stolen... I can't even focus on
class...
